newsitem.title: USA: AUTO SALES IN U.S. OFF 0.1 PCT MAY 21-30 - CNW.
newsitem.headline: AUTO SALES IN U.S. OFF 0.1 PCT MAY 21-30 - CNW.

text.p: Auto sales in the United States slipped 0.1 percent in the 10 days of May 21-30 compared with the same period a year ago, according to a report by CNW Marketing/Research.
During the survey period, sales of domestic autos decreased 0.7 percent, while U.S. sales of imports rose 3.0 percent.
Specifically, domestic car sales fell 1.1 percent, to 274,681 from 277,773, CNW said. Domestic truck sales fell 0.1 percent, to 212,618 from 212,816, it said.
Import car sales advanced 3.5 percent to 78,922, and import truck sales rose 0.7 percent to 16,374, the report said.
Year-to-date, vehicle sales in the United States reached about 6.34 million, off 0.3 percent from the same period of 1996, according to CNW.
